verdicts.reason: A buries the CTA: 'Find It Near You' is a tiny pill jammed in the top-left corner above a stack of badges. The product shrinks to a sliver under the 'BACK BY DEMAND' pill on the far right, so the left, centre and right read as three scattered clusters with no reading order. B is better: it keeps headline → GROVE → CTA pill in one central column and the product stays visible on the left. Its flaws are the body copy squeezed into a narrow six-line column at the right edge, where it is illegible at this size, and the 'FREE DELIVERY' and 'SUMMER ONLY' badges crowding the product.
